title: Birdwatch: Crowd Wisdom and Bridging Algorithms can Inform Understanding and Reduce the Spread of Misinformation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and evaluation of a matrix-factorization algorithm for ranking user-generated annotations on social media to combat misinformation. It does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as a core component; the included section on ethical considerations pertains to the conduct of the human subject research rather than the benchmarking of ethical systems.
